description: Vidrush partial cache — modifica solo il terzo segmento del payload di 02. I primi due segmenti invariati devono tornare HIT_EXACT, il terzo modificato MISS. Solo il segmento modificato deve triggerare nuove chiamate provider. Nessuna rigenerazione globale.

items.title: Vidrush partial cache: terzo segmento modificato
items.style: Write a vivid, concrete narrative. Each segment should describe a distinct visual scene. Use specific, searchable details that translate well to media queries.

source.topic: Three cinematic stories for partial cache verification
source.source_text:
A surfer rides a massive wave at sunset on the North Shore of Oahu. The golden light reflects off the water as the board cuts through the curl.

A wildlife photographer tracks a snow leopard through the Himalayan mountains. Paw prints in fresh snow lead toward a rocky outcrop at dawn.

An astronaut repairs a solar panel outside the International Space Station. Earth glows blue and white in the background as tools float in microgravity.
